messages:
Maya (Marketing): ok team — idea: a very short "lightning lane" dev tutorial series + a companion micro-benchmark post + one live workshop. focus: quick wins for integrating Redwood into OSS refkits and demo apps.
Evan (DevRel): love this. 3 mini tutorials (5–7 mins each) + 1 live 45min workshop? good to show end-to-end: setup, cost/latency tuning, and a sample eval.
Jonas (Eng): can we get a reproducible bench that runs in ~10m on a single GPU? want numbers: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and cost per 1k tokens.
Priya (Growth): inbound flow: landing page -> HubSpot form with "project type" dropdown. tag leads as "refkit-play" or "prod-migration". route to AE if >50k tokens/month.
Alex (Content): messaging draft idea: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and clear unit economics" — avoids heavy model claims, leans on ops.
Maya (Marketing): agree. keep headline benefit-led, then micro-bench callout as social card: "<60ms p50, 3x cost vs baseline" (placeholder until bench).
Evan (DevRel): for tutorials: 1) Quickstart (5m) 2) Cost & batch tuning (7m) 3) Deploy + rollouts (7m). then workshop: live Q&A + 1 guided lab.
Jonas (Eng): rough bench plan: dataset = 500 prompts (synthetic mix); models = rw-compact-8b vs opensource-8b; infra = g5 / q8; metrics = p50,p95,throughput,cost/1k. I'll script it with the repo: https://github.com/redwood/refkit-lightning
Priya (Growth): routing: add hidden form field 'bench_interest=true' if user clicks benchmark CTA. that triggers a special email drip with the benchmark summary + invite to workshop.
Alex (Content): CTA copy ideas — short options:
```
- "Try the Lightning Lane demo"
- "See the benchmark: 3 min read"
- "Join the live workshop"
```
Maya (Marketing): timeline suggestion: week 0: write tutorials + bench; week 1: teaser social + launch post; week 2: webinar. thoughts?
Evan (DevRel): timeline works. need test scripts and a reproducible make target: `make bench-lightning` in repo. Jonas can add.
Jonas (Eng): will add `bench-lightning` and a small README for repro. ETA: 4 working days.
Priya (Growth): measurement: track signups, workshop RSVPs, repo stars, and MQLs. set UTM: `utm_source=lightning_lane` and `utm_campaign=refkit_q2`.
Alex (Content): social angle: 1) teaser (gif showing throughput), 2) benchmark highlights, 3) workshop invite. keep posts short and technical.
Maya (Marketing): approvals: need legal ok on benchmark wording (no model name claims beyond tests). @Evan please loop in legal if needed.
Evan (DevRel): will ping legal. also will prepare a short demo deck for the workshop.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging for landing page preview at 2026-03-24T10:30Z :white_check_mark:
Priya (Growth): routing rules to implement in HubSpot:
```
if form.campaign == "lightning_lane" and form.bench_interest == true:
  add_tag("bench-interested")
  add_to_drip("bench-summary")
  if form.tokens_estimate >= 50000:
    assign_to_sales("AE-high-usage")
```
Maya (Marketing): todo list (short):
- [ ] Alex: publish tutorial drafts (3)
- [ ] Jonas: bench script + `make bench-lightning`
- [ ] Evan: legal + demo deck
- [ ] Priya: HubSpot routing + UTMs
- [ ] Maya: landing page + social cards
Maya (Marketing): ok everyone — I'll stitch the landing page by EOD Friday and ping for final review. any blockers?
Jonas (Eng): fine from infra side. might need a small extra GPU for the bench run during peak.
Evan (DevRel): no blockers. will start the workshop slides.
Priya (Growth): will prepare email drip content after Alex shares the benchmark copy.
Alex (Content): will drop first drafts tomorrow morning.
Maya (Marketing): thanks — will do a quick sync Friday 9am PT. :sparkles:
